text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I guess races are always gonna
make me
feel nervous. My heart's been
pounding since this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But if I win, the thought of being one
step closer to becoming the top
Umamusume in all of Japan
gets me a
little excited.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I sure will! Here I go!
choice_data_list: Let's give it everything we've got!
